title: Before the term list loads, the dropdown shows the twelve standard terms
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop's own term is the default, and you open the term dropdown before the list has loaded.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A} is the default.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-23 Fourteen.
  • Starting screen: the Customers page.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Customer".
  2. Open the Credit Terms dropdown before the term list has loaded.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Customer" window opens.
  • Step 2: it shows the twelve standard terms; as soon as the list arrives, {Term-A} is filled in as the default.

On a normal connection the list loads before the window opens, so a manual tester cannot see this state; it is for an automated check with a slowed network.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-E3: “If the term list has not loaded yet, the dropdown shows the twelve standard terms; the default is filled in as soon as the list arrives.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf): canvas pages "5 New Customer", "6 Customer on a deactivated term" (the pages the PRD names for this story). The design (read in full on 23 Oct 2026) does not draw this case's screen or state, so no design picture is attached; the expected results above come from the PRD.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - a manual tester cannot hold the term list in its loading state (it needs a slowed network)
